name: Box for "Circular Covered Box with Peony Décor"
dimensions: including lid: H. 5 x Diam. 12.1 cm (1 15/16 x 4 3/4 in.)
summary: The slightly domed cover of this circular box features a molded, carved, and incised design of a lush peony blossom supported by a slender, gently curving leafy stem.  The composition is contained within a double-line circle, which is itself surrounded by a border sporting ten lightly incised decorative scroll motifs.
